result.instructions: Tools for Honeycomb, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which datasets in our Honeycomb environment received data in the last day?"; "Run a query that counts errors by service over the last hour."; "What are the p99 latency and error rate of checkout-api this week?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Honeycomb data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run honeycomb_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run honeycomb_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run honeycomb_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. honeycomb_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: honeycomb_get_auth
tools.title: Show the connected key
tools.description: Show which Configuration Key is connected: its Environment, its Team, and the permissions it holds. Call this first to see what the other tools can do. Honeycomb API: GET /1/auth. Needs no extra permission.

tools.name: honeycomb_list_datasets
tools.title: List datasets
tools.description: List the datasets in the connected Environment with slug, description, last write time and column count. Use a slug in the other tools. Honeycomb API: GET /1/datasets. Needs the Create Datasets permission.

tools.name: honeycomb_get_dataset
tools.title: Get a dataset
tools.description: Get one dataset by slug: name, description, created time, last write time and column count. Honeycomb API: GET /1/datasets/{datasetSlug}. Needs the Create Datasets permission.

dataset.description: Dataset slug from honeycomb_list_datasets, for example `checkout-api`.

tools.name: honeycomb_list_columns
tools.title: List columns
tools.description: List the columns (fields) of a dataset with their type and description. Column names are the values for breakdowns, filters and calculations. Honeycomb API: GET /1/columns/{datasetSlug}. Needs the Manage Queries and Columns permission.

dataset.description: Dataset slug from honeycomb_list_datasets, for example `checkout-api`.

key_name.description: Return only the column with this exact name.

tools.name: honeycomb_get_query
tools.title: Get a saved query
tools.description: Get a saved query spec by id: its time range, calculations, breakdowns, filters and order. Honeycomb API: GET /1/queries/{datasetSlug}/{queryId}. Needs the Manage Queries and Columns permission.

dataset.description: Dataset slug from honeycomb_list_datasets, for example `checkout-api`.

query_id.description: The query id, from a list or create call.

tools.name: honeycomb_run_query
tools.title: Run a query
tools.description: Run a query on one dataset and return its summary rows (add include_series for the time series). It saves the query, then creates and reads its result, and it stores those query records in the Environment. Limits: 10 runs per minute, and 1 per minute for columns with relational prefixes (root., parent., child., any.). Needs the Manage Queries and Columns and Run Queries permissions. If complete is false, call honeycomb_get_query_result later. Honeycomb API: POST /1/queries, POST /1/query_results, GET /1/query_results.

dataset.description: Dataset slug from honeycomb_list_datasets, for example `checkout-api`.

time_range.description: Seconds back from now, or from end_time. Default 7200.

start_time.description: Absolute start, Unix seconds. Use with end_time.

column.description: Column to aggregate, for example `duration_ms`. Omit for COUNT.

breakdowns.description: Columns to group by. Default: none.

orders.description: Sort order of the result rows.

column.description: A breakdown or calculation column to sort by.

include_series.description: Also return the time series (large). Default false.

tools.name: honeycomb_get_query_result
tools.title: Get a query result
tools.description: Read a query result by id (from honeycomb_run_query). Returns complete false while the query still runs. Honeycomb API: GET /1/query_results/{datasetSlug}/{queryResultId}. Needs the Manage Queries and Columns and Run Queries permissions.

dataset.description: Dataset slug from honeycomb_list_datasets, for example `checkout-api`.

query_result_id.description: The query result id, from a list or create call.

tools.name: honeycomb_list_triggers
tools.title: List triggers
tools.description: List the alert triggers of a dataset with their names and alert settings. Honeycomb API: GET /1/triggers/{datasetSlug}. Needs the Manage Triggers permission.

dataset.description: Dataset slug from honeycomb_list_datasets, for example `checkout-api`.

tools.name: honeycomb_get_trigger
tools.title: Get a trigger
tools.description: Get one alert trigger by id with its full alert settings. Honeycomb API: GET /1/triggers/{datasetSlug}/{triggerId}. Needs the Manage Triggers permission.

dataset.description: Dataset slug from honeycomb_list_datasets, for example `checkout-api`.

trigger_id.description: The trigger id, from a list or create call.

tools.name: honeycomb_list_slos
tools.title: List SLOs
tools.description: List the service level objectives (SLOs) of a dataset with their names and settings. Honeycomb API: GET /1/slos/{datasetSlug}. Needs the Manage SLOs permission.

dataset.description: Dataset slug from honeycomb_list_datasets, for example `checkout-api`.

tools.name: honeycomb_get_slo
tools.title: Get an SLO
tools.description: Get one SLO by id with its settings. Set detailed to add the budget and status figures. Honeycomb API: GET /1/slos/{datasetSlug}/{sloId}. Needs the Manage SLOs permission.

dataset.description: Dataset slug from honeycomb_list_datasets, for example `checkout-api`.

slo_id.description: The SLO id, from a list or create call.

detailed.description: Return the detailed response with budget and status figures.

tools.name: honeycomb_list_boards
tools.title: List boards
tools.description: List the boards (saved dashboards) in the connected Environment. Honeycomb API: GET /1/boards. Needs the Manage Public Boards permission.

tools.name: honeycomb_get_board
tools.title: Get a board
tools.description: Get one board by id with its settings and contents. Honeycomb API: GET /1/boards/{boardId}. Needs the Manage Public Boards permission.

board_id.description: The board id, from a list or create call.

tools.name: honeycomb_list_markers
tools.title: List markers
tools.description: List the markers (event annotations such as deploys) of a dataset. Honeycomb API: GET /1/markers/{datasetSlug}. Needs the Manage Markers permission.

dataset.description: Dataset slug from honeycomb_list_datasets, for example `checkout-api`.

tools.name: honeycomb_list_recipients
tools.title: List notification recipients
tools.description: List the notification recipients of the Team. Recipients are team-wide, so this lists them for all Environments. Honeycomb API: GET /1/recipients. Needs the Manage Recipients permission.

tools.name: honeycomb_create_marker
tools.title: Create a marker
tools.description: Create a marker on a dataset graph, for example to show a deploy. Give a message, a type (such as deploy) and an optional time or time range; the default time is now. Honeycomb API: POST /1/markers/{datasetSlug}. Needs the Manage Markers permission.

dataset.description: Dataset slug from honeycomb_list_datasets, for example `checkout-api`.

message.description: What happened, for example `checkout-api v2.4.1 deployed`.

type.description: Marker type, such as `deploy`. Markers of one type share a colour.

url.description: A link for the marker, such as the release page.

start_time.description: Marker time, Unix seconds. Default: now.

end_time.description: End time, Unix seconds, for a range marker.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Honeycomb
prompts.description: What you can do with Honeycomb here, with example requests to try.
